name: whatsapp-neo-api
description: REST API for WhatsApp via whatsapp-web.js + remote Chromium — rebuilt with tsoa

scripts.dev: npm run tsoa && nodemon --watch src --ext ts,json --exec "npm run tsoa && npx tsx src/server.ts"
scripts.dev:fast: nodemon --watch src --ext ts,json --ignore src/generated --exec "npm run tsoa && npx tsx src/server.ts"
scripts.start: npm run tsoa && npx tsx src/server.ts
